name: Citizenship by Descent

qualifying_event.description: A child born outside New Zealand to a parent who is a NZ citizen by BIRTH or by GRANT (not by descent) is a citizen by descent, and must register the citizenship with the Department of Internal Affairs before it can be used (e.g. to get a NZ passport). There is no registration deadline or age limit, and the child need never have visited New Zealand. Citizenship by descent cannot itself be passed to a further generation born overseas -- only a citizen by birth or by grant can transmit it.
qualifying_event.evidence_hint: Birth certificate; parent's proof of NZ citizenship by birth or by grant (not by descent); DIA registration application.

requirements.blocker_text: The NZ-citizen parent must be a citizen by birth or by grant -- a parent who is themselves only a citizen by descent cannot transmit citizenship to a child born overseas (one-generation limit).
Must be registered as a citizen by descent with the Department of Internal Affairs before the citizenship can be used (e.g. for a passport) -- no deadline or age limit applies to registration itself.
requirements.fix_path: Apply to the DIA to register the child's citizenship by descent.

evidence_required.document: Parent's proof of NZ citizenship by birth or by grant

sources.title: New Zealand Government (govt.nz) -- Types of citizenship: confirms registration requirement for citizens by descent and that a citizen-by-descent's own overseas-born children would need citizenship by grant, not descent, to pass it on further

citizenship.co.nz -- NZ citizenship by descent for children: one-generation limit (only a parent who is a citizen by birth or by grant can transmit descent citizenship), no registration deadline or age limit
